faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for DIAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 4 November 2026, and candidates report at 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DIAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 Senior Research Fellow (SRF), 2 Junior Research Fellow (JRF).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DIAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 4 November 2026 at 11:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. Where is the walk-in interview for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Defence Institute of Advanced Technology, Girinagar, Pune.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Senior Research Fellow (SRF): maximum 32 years; Junior Research Fellow (JRF): maximum 28 years. Relaxation: SC/ST 5, Women 5, PwBD 5, OBC (NCL) 3.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: 42,000 + 30% HRA for Senior Research Fellow (SRF), 37,000 or 30,000 + 30% HRA for Junior Research Fellow (JRF).

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: B.E./B.Tech/M.Sc in relevant engineering or science disciplines with NET/GATE or M.E./M.Tech. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. No TA will be paid for attending the Walk-in-Interview.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in-Interview or online interview. Detailed scrutiny of original documents during walk-in-interview. Online interview option available.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely temporary till 31st March 2027 or co-terminus with the project, whichever is earlier. May be terminated at any time on one month's notice.
